request: an under desk mount for my Mac mini (M4, 2024), design it for 20 N

body_sources.corner_r: no radius published on https://support.apple.com/en-us/121555; 0 is the enclosing box

why: Right side up under the desk, front at -y: weight 0.67 kg (M4) or 0.73 kg (M4 Pro) on https://support.apple.com/en-us/121555 gives 6.6 N or 7.2 N, so 20 N leaves margin; Apple lists the ports 'On front' and 'On back' with no positions and the power button on the bottom is not located, so front and back stay open, the bottom is unchecked, and the mount wraps the sides and top.
